description: Empirical delivered-heat curve. q_specific(T_source) = cp*(T_source - T_return)*eta_HX*(1 - distribution_losses), tabulated as delivered kW per kg/s of geothermal flow. 1-D np.interp lookup; Q_delivered = q_specific(T_source) * m_dot.
source: Lund, J.W. & Toth, A.N. (2021). Direct Utilization of Geothermal Energy 2020 Worldwide Review, Geothermics. Breakpoints reuse EC155 F1a heat-extraction design numbers.

T_return_ref.note: Return temperature to reinjection well (F1a design)

distribution_losses.note: Pipeline thermal loss fraction, reused from F1a

pump_power_fraction.note: Circulation pump power as fraction of delivered heat

q_specific_rated.note: Delivered heat per kg/s at T_source=80, T_return=40 degC

curve.note: Delivered heat per unit flow (kW per kg/s) vs source temperature (degC) at T_return=40 degC. q = cp*(Ts-40)/1000 * 0.90 * (1-0.05).
